result.instructions: Tools for FMX, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which buildings are in our FMX tenant?"; "List the equipment records and show the details of one piece of equipment."; "Show the inventory items in our FMX tenant.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes FMX data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run fmx_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run fmx_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run fmx_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. fmx_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: fmx_list_buildings
tools.title: List buildings
tools.description: List buildings in the FMX tenant. Calls GET /api/v1/buildings and returns the response unchanged. FMX paging and filter parameters are not sent.

tools.name: fmx_get_building
tools.title: Get building
tools.description: Get one building by id. Calls GET /api/v1/buildings/{id} and returns the response unchanged.

id.description: The record id, as returned by the matching list tool.
